intent: Normalise the biopsy counts to 10,000 per cell, transform them to log2(x+1), and list the genes most up-regulated in tumour versus normal cells together with their log2 fold changes (t-test) in tumour_vs_normal.csv.
silent_error: scanpy computes logfoldchanges by undoing the log transform with expm1 using the base stored in adata.uns['log1p']['base'] (natural log if absent). A hand-made adata.X = np.log2(adata.X + 1) leaves uns['log1p'] unset, so scanpy assumes natural logs and reports log fold changes inflated by about 1/ln2 (1.44x) with a distorted per-gene pattern. sc.pp.log1p(adata, base=2) records the base. No warning is printed, exit 0, and the table looks like a normal DE table.

files.tumour_de.py:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc

adata = sc.read_csv("biopsy_counts.csv")
meta = pd.read_csv("biopsy_groups.csv", index_col=0)
adata.obs["group"] = pd.Categorical(meta.loc[adata.obs_names, "group"].values)
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
adata.X = np.log2(adata.X + 1)

sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(adata, "group", groups=["tumour"], reference="normal", method="t-test")
sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group="tumour").to_csv("tumour_vs_normal.csv", index=False)
